content: Morning's been nonstop here. Lustreshine Polish Co. rang about the fender chrome, they're our supplier for polishing now. And Ashford Frame Builders dropped off touring frames, they're supplying frames now, so please log both when you get a minute.

Hollowbrook Farm Shop left their district bikes for a tune-up, they're the shop we do district repairs for. Also a reminder the autumn cargo builds have to be out the door by 2026-12-18, so please track parts closely.
One more thing before lunch — for any spring bookings please use SERVICE-2027-V2 at checkout, that's the service code for spring. Thanks for keeping paperwork tidy!
Morning, could you remind the crew we'll be spraying frames in Cedar Booth Two today? And the truck is due in Mondays at 07:30, so have the shutter open early.
Who is running the coffee partner stall this weekend?
A bit long that one, just the name is fine next time.
Could you thank Viktor Hale tonight for handling closing for us? Also please file today's count under STOCK-2026-W4 so the paperwork stays tidy.
What was the nickname we gave the compressor?
Can you remind me which company is our helmet vendor?
Can you remind me which chat channel we use for rentals?
Could you email Northwind Cycle Parts about the charity ride event details?
Please check with me before contacting Northwind Cycle Parts.
heads up, our business advisor is now Tessa Larkin going forward.
change of plan: the rental deposit amount is now 175 euros.
heads up, our partner town event is moving to Gullwing Cove this time.
Where do I find the rentals chat channel?
Perfect, nice and short — thanks for that!
